issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change, including the required unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Read/state actions openQueue, startRename, openAccess and confirmToggle resolve scoped models but never call authorize, so mount-only auth can be bypassed on Livewire updates.
Server-influenced IDs viewingQueueId, editingQueueId and accessQueueId are public without #[Locked] and inputs name, renameName, mode and selectedQueueId have no #[Validate].
Rename passes the raw name as slug instead of a re-derived slug, so renaming Old to New would not yield slug new unless the action slugifies.
Detail and toggle-confirmation buttons always render ui.queues_deactivate and never ui.queues_reactivate for inactive queues.
Tampered mode flows directly into CallMode::from and raises ValueError instead of a validation error.
Queues routes add no route-level authorization, so employees-get-403 on the route is not enforced in the diff.
No #[Validate] plus $this->validate() before persisting and no docs/CHANGELOG sync, contrary to the Livewire and docs-freshness conventions.
Serve mode selector uses a hardcoded English Mode label and untranslated option text.
Navbar gates queues with update on the entity while mount gates create on Queue, an ability mismatch for manager-only visibility.

conventions.evidence: Uses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess (Queues.php:34-36), Gate allows call (Serve.php:297,342), Bulma boxes/modals; but no #[Validate]+$this->validate() on name/renameName/mode and IDs not #[Locked] (Queues.php:53-60), no docs/CHANGELOG update

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with clear names matching sibling Blade/Bulma style (queues.blade.php:512-520, serve.blade.php:719-737); nits: hardcoded Mode label serve.blade.php:704

requirements.evidence: Covers Queues.php:62 mount create auth, Queues.php:229 scoped accessQueue null-safe, Serve.php:339 scoped find plus mayCall gate with priority/issued_at/id limit 30; but Queues.php:149 slug raw, queues.blade.php:570 never reactivate, Serve.php:318 unvalidated CallMode::from, routes/web.php:748 no route can-guard

scope.evidence: All hunks serve queues/serve/tabs/nav/lang/routes; extra queues_active/inactive/reactivate keys support required status display, no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Scoped findOrFail everywhere (Queues.php:103,179,204; Serve.php:315) and #[Locked] lastCalledTicketId (Serve.php:277); but openQueue/startRename/openAccess/confirmToggle lack authorize and public IDs lack #[Locked]

simplicity.evidence: Lean reuse of existing Actions/policies/Bulma modal pattern, e.g. callableQueues() filter Serve.php:292-299 and viewedQueue() helper Queues.php:218-225, no new layers

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no test files; no happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call or tamper tests

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve Livewire pages, members tabs, nav links, routes and bilingual lang keys with correctly scoped lookups and safe foreign-id handling. Missing tests, missing per-action authorization and Locked/Validate attributes, plus slug, reactivate-label, mode-validation and route-guard gaps, require substantial rework before merge.
